content: I really like the style of verso documentation, and I'd like to replace docgen in my repository with verso pages. Is there a template somewhere that does this? What I would like is to automatically generate one page per Lean file in my repository, that lists every Lean declaration in the file.

We don't yet have this feature.

Now that doc-gen builds a database from which it generates its own HTML, it's pretty feasible to implement, and I'd like to bring them closer together.

Thanks!
I just found https://github.com/optpku/ReasBook/ and it looks like they do something like that to generate verso pages for all the books they formalized.
